body: Full acceptance has passed lint, typecheck, 5,060 application tests plus 105 Fireguard tests, and coverage (98% statements, 95.16% branches). Deadcode found the newly exported ShakeState type has no external consumer. The acceptance worker is removing only that unused type export as integration cleanup, without altering the type/runtime implementation or the ignore baseline, then rerunning affected checks. The accepted Fireguard result remains evidence for unchanged behavioral tests; its exact graded head and the later type-only cleanup will be recorded distinctly.
